text: Any exercise of the multisig endowment wallet keys ultimately depends on a vote in the assembly of the DAO association that serves as legal wrapper, so a donor holding one key among many is involved in endowment payment decisions without controlling them.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How Decentralized Autonomous Organizations Optimize Charitable Giving (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3981021

isBasedOn.name: How Decentralized Autonomous Organizations Optimize Charitable Giving

abstract: The exercise of the multisig wallet keys will ultimately always depend on a CHARITYxDAO vote in the assembly of the CHARITYxDAO association (the legal wrapper – if chosen to be a Swiss Association). As a multisig key holder, the donor will be involved in multisig endowment payment

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: endowment wallets held in a DAO legal wrapper such as a Swiss Association
